ValidationRule.description: Fill in only the subject that matches the Scope: Subject User for User, Subject Record Id for Related Record. A scope is required.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: OR(AND(ISPICKVAL(Scope__c, "User"), OR(ISBLANK(SubjectUser__c), NOT(ISBLANK(SubjectRecordId__c)))), AND(ISPICKVAL(Scope__c, "Related Record"), OR(ISBLANK(SubjectRecordId__c), NOT(ISBLANK(SubjectUser__c)))), ISPICKVAL(Scope__c, ""))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in only the subject that matches the Scope: Subject User for User, Subject Record Id for Related Record. A scope is required.
